title: Why America’s Semiconductor Manufacturing Capacity Matters
gist: Daniel Nenni's commentary on an Intel Foundry editorial argues that US chip manufacturing capacity matters because production and innovation reinforce each other, citing the US share of global chip manufacturing falling from 37% in 1990 to 10% in 2022. It lists Intel's Arizona Fab 62 (operations expected by end of 2028), its Ohio milestone, and 4,500 suppliers across 49 states with over $29 billion in annual domestic spending.

insights.claim: Citing the Semiconductor Industry Association, America's share of global semiconductor manufacturing fell from 37% in 1990 to 10% in 2022.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
